title: Deeper C#
units/0/blurb: What every object has: System.Object, the header and the type pointer, the Equals/GetHashCode contract; casts, is, as and unboxing; primitives, checked and overflow, dynamic and its cost.
units/1/blurb: Boxing you cannot see in the code: interfaces, GetType and ValueType methods; a mutable struct in a collection and in foreach; ValueType.Equals via reflection, IEquatable<T>, record struct and field layout.
units/2/blurb: What breaks for a library consumer without a recompile: const versus static readonly, initialization order and beforefieldinit, virtual/new/override and call/callvirt, operators, conversions and extension methods up to C# 14 extension blocks.
units/3/blurb: ref inside out: ref readonly, ref returns and CollectionsMarshal; where default values live and what version 2 breaks; params and params ReadOnlySpan; properties, field, init and required in metadata; anonymous types, ValueTuple and Deconstruct.
units/4/blurb: Why they exist, how the JIT compiles them for value and reference types, where constraints, covariance and contravariance, and generic math with INumber<T>.
units/5/blurb: Explicit implementation and why a struct behind an interface lives in a box, how the CLR finds an interface method; default methods and the "version 2" scenario, static abstract members, interface or base class.
units/6/blurb: Func and Action, multicast delegates, events and subscription leaks, lambdas and what exactly they capture; what a delegate is inside: a MulticastDelegate class, chains and exceptions in them, explicit add/remove.
units/7/blurb: A string in memory and the literal pool, ordinal versus culture and the Turkish i, Concat, StringBuilder, the interpolation handler, string.Create and u8 literals; enums as a struct over an integer, baked-in values and [Flags]; the cost of array covariance, jagged versus multidimensional, InlineArray, boxing int?.
units/8/blurb: What finally guarantees and when it does not run, when filters and two-pass handling, throw vs throw ex and ExceptionDispatchInfo, a type broken for good, what crashes the process, the cost of an exception, TryXxx and your own exceptions.
units/9/blurb: A custom attribute and where it lives in metadata, AttributeUsage and pseudo-attributes; the cost of reflection: Invoke, delegates, Expression, UnsafeAccessor and Activator; source generators instead of reflection, trimming and Native AOT.
units/10/blurb: Deferred execution and Take, ToList and multiple enumeration, the buffering OrderBy, IQueryable and SQL from lambdas.
units/11/blurb: Span<T> and copy-free slices, the rules of ref struct and Memory<T>, readonly struct, in and defensive copies.
units/12/blurb: Pattern matching, records, nullable references, required and what is new in C# 12, 13 and 14. The course final.
